calendar.what: Black Friday week. COS ~25% (members and subscribers first), Arket ~20% on autumn/winter, A&F 25–50% plus an extra-15% code, Massimo Dutti ~40% (app first, 27 Nov last year). You fly to Riga on Fri 27 Nov, so order before you leave or from your phone.
Winter sales. Massimo Dutti opens in the app on the evening of 26 Dec (~30%, later 50–60%). COS and Arket from late Dec, up to 50% and deeper in January. A&F clearance plus codes.
Italian winter sales: the best time for Premiata at Italian boutiques and Farfetch (20–45% off).
Summer sales: Inditex (Massimo Dutti) from ~24 Jun online, COS ~1 Jul with 24h early access for members. Good for linen, clogs and summer knits.
Portugal has no fixed sale dates, but the 'was' price must be the lowest price of the last 90 days, so a sale price is a real discount.
